verdict.rationale: The evidence documents event-triggered workflows ('create and trigger unique business workflows to notify, update, or validate information') and MCP-connected agents that 'monitor, reason, and act'. Neither describes defining a recurring, time-based schedule for jobs or workflows. Trigger-based automation and agent autonomy are adjacent capabilities, not scheduling, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
